Thesis

From thesis to signing, as one piece of work.

Strategy, valuation, capital structure and negotiation are worked together, with the client, until the file is ready to sign.

  • 01

    Origination

    We identify companies, assets, buyers, lenders and partners that can become an operation.

  • 02

    Due diligence

    We review the financial, sector, operating and documentary side: risks, contingencies, and whether the project can hold.

  • 03

    Valuation

    We value companies and assets, with models, sensitivities and the effect on the transaction.

  • 04

    Capital structure

    We design debt, equity, co-investment and acquisition finance.

  • 05

    M&A

    Buys, sells and target search, with negotiation through close.

  • 06

    Fundraising

    We prepare the file for family offices, funds and private investors, inside the applicable rules.

  • 07

    Real assets

    We structure mining, industrial, energy, infrastructure and real-estate projects, on the numbers and on the ground.

  • 08

    Cross-border

    Market entry, joint ventures, local partners and execution where the operation sits.

Team

The founding partners

  • Juan Balbontin

    Real estate, infrastructure, private capital

    In Mexico he works in real estate, infrastructure and private capital with investors, developers and operators. He comes from commercial and real-estate development inside large groups. Economics, University of Georgia. He works in Spanish and English.

  • Ana María Almeida Luján

    Due diligence, capital structure, mining

    She leads due diligence and capital structure, above all in mining, industry and energy. She works with banks, funds and family offices. She chairs the financial-services section of CANACO Chihuahua. She works in Spanish and English.

  • Patrick Diogo

    M&A, valuation, energy

    He handles valuation and M&A, including cross-border oil and gas. Economics at the University of Lyon; specialized master’s in finance at emlyon. He works in French, English, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.

  • Gregory Prudhommeaux

    Market entry, alliances, cross-border execution

    He originates projects, joint ventures and capital across Europe, Asia and the Americas. Seventeen years in China; in Mexico since 2023. Conseiller du Commerce Extérieur de la France and CCI France México in Jalisco. He works in French, English, Spanish and Mandarin.
